# WealthNX

> WealthNX is an AI-powered personal finance platform that helps people organize and understand their financial information through tracking, analysis, insights, and planning tools.

WealthNX offers tools for reviewing financial activity, understanding cash flow and spending, tracking net worth, exploring portfolio and market data, and examining financial trends. Features may present actual, estimated, projected, simulated, or AI-generated information; consult the relevant page for details.

## Important Context
WealthNX provides financial tracking, analysis, educational information, and AI-generated insights. It is not a personalized investment advisory service and does not guarantee financial outcomes. Market and portfolio tools are intended to help users understand information, not to direct users to buy, sell, or hold investments.
